hints.title: Submask Condition
hints.text: Allowed operations can only clear a bit from one to zero. Hence k must be a submask of n.

hints.title: Bitwise Validity Check
hints.text: If the bitwise union of n and k does not equal n, at least one bit position requires turning zero into one which is impossible.

hints.title: Bitwise Difference Count
hints.text: When valid, the required changes correspond to bit positions set in n but zero in k, equivalent to counting set bits in the bitwise difference.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: n, k: input integers up to 10^6
complexity.notes: Bitwise operations execute in constant processor cycles.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Looping through 32 individual bit iterations is less concise than bitwise masks.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses submask property (n | k) == n and popcount.
